purpose: Configuration and separation policy for the MORNING graded-DCA stream, which now has TWO modes. (1) A 9:45 AM ET read-only watchlist / early-warning scan (mode='watchlist', run_type='morning_dca_watchlist_scan', trades=false): analytics only, no orders, no Robinhood order review, no broker placement; it may surface early candidates but every dollar amount is hypothetical / watchlist-only. (2) A 10:30 AM ET live Robinhood execution (mode='live', run_type='morning_dca_live', trades=true) using a true 60-minute intraday trend window. Both modes share the shared $2-base 0x-to-5x live ladder and the morning budget ledger but write to distinct artifact roots. Both are INDEPENDENT of, and never valid evidence for, the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b).
confidence_rule: In LIVE mode, a candidate whose price/drop passes the ladder is auto-bought ONLY when the intraday trend can be validated (>= trend_min_bars usable intraday bars at or before the decision time). If price/drop passes but the intraday trend cannot be validated, the run must NOT auto-buy; it classifies the candidate as execution_status='manual_review_candidate'. There is no loosened trend-unavailable execution path.

watchlist_task.name: Morning graded DCA watchlist / early-warning scan
watchlist_task.note: Analytics / read-only only. Identifies early candidates but labels every amount hypothetical / watchlist-only. Places no trades, runs no Robinhood order review, calls no broker placement path.

preflight_task.name: Morning graded DCA pre-flight validation

machine_complete_contract.reason: On Mon Jul 13 2026 the 10:30 AM live execution was blocked because the 9:45 artifact lacked machine-readable gate fields (top-level overall_ok and a per-ticker eligible_to_execute list). The 9:45 pre-flight run_state.json must now ALWAYS write these machine fields so the 10:30 live task can gate directly off them.
machine_complete_contract.per_ticker_coverage: per_ticker_eligibility contains every active-universe symbol exactly once.
machine_complete_contract.unresolved_ticker_rule: Unresolved symbols (e.g. AAAU, SPCX) are emitted as per-symbol rows with eligible_to_execute=false and ineligible_reason='unresolved_ticker' (or a specific lookup/tradability failure code) and are listed in unresolved_tickers. They MUST NOT set overall_ok=false or invalidate the whole artifact as long as the other required fields were written.
machine_complete_contract.overall_ok_rule: overall_ok is false ONLY for global/account/buying-power/auth/schema-write failures (recorded in blocking_errors), never for individual unresolved or ineligible tickers.
machine_complete_contract.not_evaluated_fields: The read-only coarse pre-flight does not bind a broker account or evaluate spread/trend, so account_ok, buying_power_ok, spread_pct, spread_ok are null and trend_status is 'not_evaluated_preflight'; the 10:30 live run computes them fresh.

preflight_task.eligibility_semantics: eligible_to_execute is a COARSE pre-screen answering 'should the 10:30 live evaluator re-evaluate this ticker?', NOT a final buy approval. A ticker is eligible when it graded to a positive-multiplier BUY at 9:45 with a usable current price and previous close. The 10:30 live run recomputes signals/budget/spread/trend/top-up from scratch and may still decline; an ineligible ticker is skipped by the 10:30 gate.
preflight_task.note: Read-only pre-screen for the 10:30 live executor. Places no trades, runs no Robinhood order review, calls no broker placement path. Writes a machine-complete run_state.json (schema morning-preflight-v2-machine-complete). The 10:30 live run loads the same-day preflight artifact and evaluates only eligible_to_execute=true tickers; if the artifact is missing, a SCHEDULED live run fails closed (evaluates zero tickers and writes a blocked run_state artifact) -- only a MANUAL live run degrades to the full universe with a warning. Corrected 2026-07-19 (Copilot review, PR #78): _apply_preflight_gate() in morning_dca.py fails closed for scheduled runs, it does not degrade to the full universe.

live_task.name: Weekday 10:30 AM morning DCA live Robinhood execution
live_task.cron_utc_note: 14:30 UTC weekdays; ET equivalent 10:30 AM during US Eastern Daylight Time (EDT, UTC-4).
live_task.note: Live Robinhood execution using account 562057042 as the sole execution broker (Alpaca/Finance/Yahoo stay read-only for validation/context). Uses a true 60-minute intraday trend window (moved from the former 9:45 AM live slot). PRE-AUTHORIZED direct placement (user approved 2026-07-10 11:20 AM ET): for scheduled live runs only it MUST NOT request per-order confirmation and MUST NOT call Robinhood review_equity_order; it calls place_equity_order directly ONLY after every safeguard (signal, budget, spread, data confidence, trend validation, top-up, circuit breakers) passes. Manual/ad hoc runs still go through Robinhood's review + confirmation path: review_equity_order (review_market_buy) must pass before place_equity_order (place_market_buy) is attempted; if Robinhood's own review requires additional post-review confirmation (e.g. a step-up/2FA gate), placement raises OrderConfirmationRequiredError and the run records not_submitted_confirmation_required with no order placed -- there is no separate confirmation step implemented in this code beyond that broker-driven gate. DEPENDS on the same-day 9:45 pre-flight artifact and evaluates only eligible_to_execute=true tickers, then recomputes a FRESH price, prior close, spread, 60-minute downtrend, signal, and budget before placing; if the trend cannot be validated it does NOT auto-buy (skip / manual_review_candidate). If the pre-flight artifact is missing, a SCHEDULED run fails closed (_apply_preflight_gate() evaluates zero tickers and writes a blocked run_state artifact) rather than blocking all buys via a full-universe fallback; only a MANUAL run degrades to the full universe with a warning. Subject to the confidence_rule and to the GFUZ special handling (see gfuz_special_handling), the raw-data persistence contract (see raw_data_persistence), and the automatic failure recovery contract (see automatic_failure_recovery).

gfuz_special_handling.reason: Robinhood is the primary quote/prior-close source for GFUZ because Finance (and other read-only providers) may not resolve it. Alpaca/Finance/Yahoo remain read-only validation/context only.

supplemental_preflight.trigger: If the same-day 9:45 pre-flight artifact does not contain a GFUZ row (e.g. GFUZ was unresolved at 9:45), the 10:30 live task must run a supplemental GFUZ read-only validation before decisioning GFUZ.
supplemental_preflight.rule: Persist the supplemental GFUZ read-only validation to gfuz_supplemental_preflight.json BEFORE any GFUZ signal/budget/top-up/order decisioning; the decision engine reads GFUZ only from the persisted file.
supplemental_preflight.implementation_status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in MorningDCAExecutor (morning_dca.py) as of 2026-07-18 -- flagged by Codex review on PR #78 ('Add the GFUZ supplemental path before gating it out'). _apply_preflight_gate currently admits tickers via a plain `tickers ∩ eligible_tickers` intersection with no GFUZ-specific exception, so a same-day preflight artifact missing a GFUZ row places GFUZ in gated_out_tickers and it is simply not evaluated that run (a safe, fail-closed degradation -- GFUZ is skipped, never bought on unvalidated data) rather than running this supplemental validation. Left as documented follow-up work rather than implemented unreviewed in a review-comment pass; GFUZ's active-universe membership itself is unaffected and unchanged.

raw_data_persistence.reason: RAW DATA PERSISTENCE FIX (added Jul 15 2026, confirmed Jul 16 2026): before any signal computation, budget calculation, top-up calculation, or order placement, the 10:30 live task must persist every raw connector response used by the run so the decision engine reads only from persisted files (mirrors the afternoon 10ce362c fix).
rules: Before any signal computation, budget calculation, top-up calculation, or order placement, persist every raw Robinhood/Finance/Alpaca/Yahoo connector response used by the run under morning_dca/YYYYMMDD_1030ET/raw/ using deterministic filenames.
Normalize large connector output_path / wrapped outputs into parseable JSON before persisting (referenced contents under 'data', original pointer preserved under 'output_path').
The decision engine must read ONLY from the persisted files under raw/, never from in-memory tool responses. Order of operations: fetch -> persist -> normalize -> compute -> place.
If data fetch succeeds but raw persistence or normalization fails, do NOT place orders; still write run_state.json with the blocking reason (raw_persistence_error) and no orders placed.
raw_data_persistence.implementation_status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in MorningDCAExecutor (morning_dca.py) as of 2026-07-18 -- flagged as a P1 by Codex review on PR #78 ('Implement v2 persistence before emitting v2 artifacts'). The afternoon stream's run_pipeline() (run_dca.py) genuinely calls save_raw_input/build_raw_persistence_state/raw_persistence_failure_run_state from scripts/run_classification.py; MorningDCAExecutor.run() has no equivalent call and evaluates directly from the in-memory data provider. This does not by itself cause an unsafe order (all existing safeguards -- trend validation, budget caps, spread, confidence rule -- still run against whatever data was fetched), but the run_state_fields this section documents (raw_input_dir, raw_inputs_saved, raw_persistence_error) are never populated, so a downstream consumer checking those fields for compliance would be misled. Deliberately left as flagged follow-up work rather than adding a large, untested new persistence/recovery code path to a live-trading executor within a review-comment-response pass; needs an explicit decision to either implement it (mirroring run_dca.py's pattern) or formally step the live task back to a schema tag that doesn't claim it.
raw_data_persistence.state_schema_version_caveat: state_schema_version='morning-live-v2-preauthorized' is currently written on every scheduled 10:30 run regardless of raw-persistence implementation_status above; the version tag is a forward-looking contract label the code has not yet fully caught up to, not a passed/failed runtime check.

automatic_failure_recovery.summary: If the 10:30 live run fails because of internal persistence, parsing, wrapper-normalization, transient connector throttling, or a raw-file write problem AFTER data was fetched, it immediately reruns the required read-only inputs once, persists all raw responses first, recomputes only from persisted files, and continues the same guarded execution if safeguards pass.
rules: Trigger only on recoverable internal failures after data was fetched: persistence, parsing, wrapper-normalization, transient connector throttling, or raw-file write problems.
Rerun required read-only inputs exactly once; persist all raw responses first; recompute only from the persisted files; continue the same guarded execution if all safeguards pass.
Reuse the SAME logical run directory (morning_dca/YYYYMMDD_1030ET/) with recovery_rerun=true; never classify a recovery rerun as manual (run_origin stays 'scheduled', manual_run stays false).
If the recovery rerun also fails, or a safety/account/order rejection occurs, write run_state.json with the blocking reason and escalate.
automatic_failure_recovery.implementation_status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in MorningDCAExecutor (morning_dca.py) as of 2026-07-18, same Codex finding as raw_data_persistence.implementation_status above -- there is no recovery-rerun code path in morning_dca.py's run(), so recovery_rerun/recovery_reason/recovery_attempts are never populated on any morning artifact.

manual_missed_run_recovery.summary: When the scheduled 10:30 AM live morning task did not run (missed scheduled fire), a human-triggered manual recovery may place the missed morning buys by hand. These MANUAL missed-morning recovery artifacts are written under a dedicated manual_recovery/ path and are prior-allocation / same-day top-up context ONLY. They are NEVER proof that the 10:30 scheduled task ran and NEVER scheduled evidence.
manual_missed_run_recovery.example_note: Jul 20 2026 manual missed-morning recovery: the 10:30 scheduled morning live task did not run, so a manual recovery ran at 10:48 AM ET and wrote artifacts under manual_recovery/20260720_1048ET.
rules: Valid as prior-allocation / same-day top-up context ONLY when run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, and valid_scheduled_evidence=false all hold.
MUST NEVER count as proof that the 10:30 scheduled task ran.
MUST NEVER be written into the midday or afternoon scheduled evidence stream.
MUST NEVER be used for scheduled reliability, scheduled fill counts, scheduled slippage, scheduled cost basis, or watchdog confirmation.
MAY ONLY reduce or block additional buys through the same-day top-up rule: a later run buys max(0, desired - prior) and only if the later decision price is strictly below the prior reference price.
The 12:30 midday run and the 3:20 final run MUST scan manual_recovery/YYYYMMDD_* for same-day manual recovery artifacts and fold them into the top-up guard as prior allocation.

live_schedule_hardening_2026_07_20.trigger_incident: On Jul 20 2026 the 10:30 scheduled morning live run failed: it invoked a saved runner without first generating the same-day raw inputs and escalated without persisting a scheduled failure-state artifact.

raw_input_generation.summary: The 10:30 scheduled live morning task MUST NOT assume runner inputs already exist, except the same-day 9:45 pre-flight artifact. Before invoking any saved runner or order module, it MUST create the raw directory and persist all required raw inputs for the current same-day run.
raw_input_generation.only_assumed_input: /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/morning_dca_preflight/YYYYMMDD_0945ET/run_state.json (or latest_preflight.json when it points to that same-day file).
required_inputs: historical / trend bars needed for the 60-minute trend check
raw_input_generation.run_date_arg: If a runner requires a RUN_DATE_ET argument, pass the current America/New_York date as YYYYMMDD.
raw_input_generation.no_stale_reuse: Do NOT reuse stale files from a prior run.
raw_input_generation.data_sources: Finance connector primary, Alpaca and Robinhood validation/context, yfinance fallback ONLY when connector data is unavailable, stale, incomplete, or unresolved.
raw_input_generation.bounded_recovery: If raw input generation fails once, perform ONE bounded recovery attempt with the alternate approved data source path, then stop.

blocked_state.when: If a missing pre-flight artifact, missing/invalid raw inputs, trend, budget, tradability, spread, or broker condition blocks execution, write a valid scheduled morning run_state.
blocked_state.order_submit_status: Concrete status such as not_submitted_error or not_submitted_blocked.
blocked_state.error_class: Concrete class such as missing_preflight_artifact or missing_or_invalid_raw_inputs.
blocked_state.missing_inputs_field: Include a compact list of missing files or failed data sources.

evidence_meaning: This failure-state artifact is valid proof that the 10:30 scheduled task FIRED, but it is NOT order or fill evidence.
no_silent_escalation: Do NOT escalate without writing this state file unless the workspace itself is unavailable.
post_raw_failure_rule: If failure happens after raw collection has started, write morning_signals.csv when possible, an empty submitted_orders.csv with headers when no orders were placed, and run_state.json. Do not leave a half-done run with no state file.

artifacts.manifest_accuracy_note: Corrected 2026-07-18 (Codex review, PR #78: 'Match the live artifact manifest to the writer') and re-corrected 2026-07-19 (Codex/Copilot follow-up review) to match MorningDCAExecutor.write_artifacts(): the scheduled 10:30 live run writes run_state.json and morning_signals.csv (via signals_csv_name) ONLY as always_write -- not 'signals.csv', and NOT run_summary.json/validation.csv (those are written only in preflight mode). submitted_orders.csv IS written by this task, but conditionally: write_artifacts() emits a row per ticker for every broker_outcomes entry with status=='submitted', so the file is written whenever the scheduled run actually submits at least one order (see write_if_applicable). filled_orders.csv is never written by this task -- morning_dca.py has no fill-confirmation step; that filename only appears under a morning run directory via a separate manual-override process (see near_close_dca.py/scripts/run_classification.py).
artifacts.gfuz_supplemental: gfuz_supplemental_preflight.json (only when the 9:45 pre-flight lacked GFUZ; see gfuz_special_handling). NOT YET IMPLEMENTED -- see gfuz_special_handling.implementation_status.

sizing_ladder.name: live_0x_to_5x
sizing_ladder.tier_boundary_rule: min inclusive, max exclusive; the largest tier threshold <= actual drop wins; drop < 0.1% = 0x (no buy).
sizing_ladder.separation_note: As of the Fri Jul 10 2026 live-automation update the morning live stream uses the SAME shared $2-base 0x-to-5x ladder as the midday and afternoon streams (config/sizing_ladder.json). The former morning-only 0x-to-3x ladder (0.1-2/2-5/5-8/8+ -> 1x/1.5x/2x/3x) is HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED. Max per order is therefore 5x * $2 = $10.

budget_ledger.separation_note: The morning ledger is a separate session from the afternoon StrategyState / BUDGET_TIERS ledger. Morning buys (live) or hypothetical amounts (watchlist) never consume or validate the afternoon 3:20 daily/weekly budget.

artifact_paths.manual_recovery_note: manual_recovery/YYYYMMDD_* holds MANUAL missed-morning 10:30 recovery artifacts (run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, valid_scheduled_evidence=false). See manual_missed_run_recovery. They are same-day prior-allocation / top-up context only for the later midday (12:30) and afternoon (3:20) runs; they are never scheduled evidence and never prove the 10:30 scheduled task ran.
artifact_paths.separation_note: Each morning mode writes ONLY under its own root. None writes into /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/**, updates latest_scheduled_run.json, or touches afternoon scheduled_runs/ folders. The 10:30 live run READS (never writes) the same-day preflight root to load eligible_to_execute. The legacy 'morning_run_state_root' key mirrors the watchlist root for backwards compatibility. prior_allocation_roots lists all roots scanned for earlier same-day manual fills so the morning live run applies the per-ticker top-up offset guard. cap_seed_roots covers the full morning_dca tree (manual_runs/ plus scheduled YYYYMMDD_1030ET/ slots) so a restart or scheduler retry seeds from any prior morning fill; it intentionally excludes afternoon roots like ce16ba6b so afternoon recovery fills do not exhaust the morning daily cap.

top_up_guard.purpose: Morning live orders/fills are recorded as prior same-day allocation context so the afternoon 3:20 task can offset (top up) rather than duplicate the same-day position. This is the ONLY way morning activity feeds the afternoon stream.
top_up_guard.price_rule: When earlier same-day buys exist for a ticker, the afternoon task only buys if the current price is strictly below the prior-run reference price; otherwise it holds.
top_up_guard.note: These are the actual fields emitted per buy_candidate in buy_candidates rows by near_close_dca.run_once when the top-up guard is active; morning fills populate prior_same_day_* for the afternoon evaluation.

downstream_separation_rules: Afternoon consumers glob only /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/scheduled_runs/** and therefore never traverse either morning root.
A morning run_state has stream='morning' and valid_afternoon_evidence=false; any consumer must exclude it from afternoon scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, and order-count metrics.
Neither morning mode updates latest_scheduled_run.json or writes into afternoon scheduled/manual folders.

Morning fills (live) count only as PRIOR-ALLOCATION CONTEXT for the afternoon same-day top-up guard; they are never afternoon scheduled evidence, slippage, watchdog confirmation, scheduled cost basis, or scheduled fill counts.
